jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Valence

We're the only company pioneering leadership coaching for large enterprises in an AI-first way. Our mission is to transform how the world's biggest companies approach learning and development, helping teams work better together through AI-powered personalization that adapts to individual goals and organizational culture using the latest advances in machine learning and natural language processing.

Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365 https://www.valence.co/blog/valence-microsoft-365-may-2026

We've been featured in Harvard Business Review, TIME, World Economic Forum, Financial Times, Forbes and an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America. Our clients represent the most diverse and sophisticated enterprise AI implementations globally, including Coca-Cola, Delta, Nestlé, General Mills, Schneider Electric, Deutsche Telekom, AstraZeneca, Prudential, CVS and Bristol Myers Squibb.

The Role

This is a chance to own a strategic bet, not a backlog. As a Staff PM you'll take an ambiguous, company-level bet and turn it into shipped outcomes across multiple projects, deciding what we invest in, what we drop, and what "good" means along the way. This role is exciting because:

 - Real ownership, not coordination: You'll own a multi-project bet from concept to adoption. You decompose it, sequence it, and answer for the outcome, often without a PM manager above you.

 - Judgment is the job: AI has collapsed the cost of specs, prototypes, and analyses. What's scarce now is taste and the willingness to make hard calls under ambiguity. That's what we're hiring for.

 - You'll multiply, not just ship: Other PMs will cite your judgment. The standards you set for how we scope, launch, and close the loop will outlive any single project.

 - AI-native from day one: We're building from first principles, not layering AI onto legacy systems, and you'll work that way too, with AI doing the bulk of analysis, prototyping, and synthesis while you do the framing and the deciding.

 - High performing PDE culture: We operate as a tight, collaborative product-design-engineering team with intentional practices that make distributed work effective and energizing.

This is a generic Staff PM role. We'll match you to a specific bet based on your strengths and where the company needs the most leverage.



What You'll Do

 - Own a strategic bet that spans multiple projects, from concept through adoption, including the metric it's accountable to

 - Develop and evangelize the strategy for that bet over months, build executive conviction on it, and defend your recommendations under pressure

 - Set the product taste bar across the bet: talk to customers directly, walk the flows, and hold a clear POV on what great looks like

 - Design workflows where AI does the bulk of the analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and set the verification standards that keep that work honest

 - Self-serve your own answers: write your own SQL, run your own analyses in Metabase and Amplitude, prototype in Claude/Devin/Lovable when that's the fastest path to a real answer

 - Improve how the org ships: planning rituals, post-launch reviews, prioritization loops, and the systemic bottlenecks nobody has owned yet

What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years of product management experience, including a track record of owning multi-project, strategic bets end-to-end

 - Evidence you can turn ambiguity into a shipped outcome: you've taken something with no playbook and made it real

 - Demonstrated ability to build executive conviction and land tough no's, including upward

 - A history of shipping fast on small teams, where you did the work yourself rather than directing others to do it

 - Fluency with data: you pull it, model it, and use it to pressure-test your own ideas rather than confirm them

 - Daily, sophisticated use of AI in your own workflow, and a clear-eyed view of where it fails: hallucinated metrics, vibe-coded prototypes, plausible-but-wrong output

 - Experience developing other PMs, formally or informally

 - Bonus if you've worked on conversational, LLM-powered, or agentic products, or sold into large enterprises

You Thrive When You're

 - Making hard calls with incomplete information, then updating fast when the evidence contradicts you

 - Collaborating intensively, thinking out loud, riffing with eng and design, and building on others' ideas

 - Picking the right artifact for the job (a PRD, a Loom, a prototype, or a one-paragraph hypothesis), and never the wrong one out of habit

 - Going back to the data after launch and reading it honestly, including when it says you were wrong

 - Multiplying through frameworks, rituals, and coaching rather than doing everything yourself

This Isn't the Right Fit If You

Need a defined roadmap handed to you, or a manager to unblock you

 - Measure your contribution in specs written or features launched rather than outcomes moved

 - Prefer long stretches of solo, heads-down work

 - Want clearly defined swim lanes and minimal ambiguity

 - Need large teams or heavy processes to feel productive

 - Insist on hand-writing every PRD and analysis

What you'll get

Ownership & Rapid Growth

 - Outsized missions from day one, with direct responsibility for company-defining projects

 - Work alongside the executive team with transparency into strategy and decision-making

 - Influence on direction through real-time customer feedback and market insights

AI-First Operator

 - Work directly with cutting-edge AI models and next-generation platforms

 - Build expertise in enterprise AI implementation across Fortune 500 companies and multiple industries

 - Establish yourself as a recognized leader among peers in shaping how AI transforms work at a global scale

Compensation

 - Competitive salary including base + bonuses

 - Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one

 - Generous PTO, company-wide R&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave

 - Retirement plan support for US and global employees

Equity

 - Meaningful ownership in a venture-backed company at a growth inflection point

 - Financial upside that comes from scaling fast

 - Top-up grants as we scale and you deliver exceptional performance — your compensation grows alongside your impact

Top-Performing Culture

 - A culture built for top talent: intensity to win, growth without limits, and a team that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together

 

Learn more about us and meet our team here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VGYZ59n_x-c

 

Valence takes candidate fraud seriously. We verify identity, LinkedIn profiles, employment history, and references; any misrepresentation during the hiring process is grounds for withdrawing an offer or ending employment. All offers are contingent on successful completion of these checks.

 

#LI-HYBRID

We've been featured in Harvard Business Review, TIME, World Economic Forum, Financial Times, Forbes and an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America. Our clients represent the most diverse and sophisticated enterprise AI implementations globally, including Coca-Cola, Delta, Nestlé, General Mills, Schneider Electric, Deutsche Telekom, AstraZeneca, Prudential, CVS and Bristol Myers Squibb.

Working at Valence means building the team behind one of the fastest-growing companies in enterprise AI. You'll recruit across GTM and technical roles for a business trusted by the likes of Coca-Cola, Delta, and Bristol Myers Squibb; partnering directly with leadership, owning your process end-to-end, and shaping who gets to define what AI-first transformation looks like. The bar is high, and you'll be the one who holds it.


THE ROLE

Nadia https://www.valence.co/videos/meet-nadia-2 is evolving and redefining the Talent tech stack. At her heart she’s an AI coach, but as she sits alongside each employee she becomes a front door and connector of talent programs - and delivers the personalized, real-time, and in-the-flow-of-work learning, performance management, and engagement that drives real gains in individual and team performance. This role will help write the story of how AI-enabled coaching transforms how organizations redefine how performance and development are delivered at the world’s leading workplaces.

You'll own positioning, messaging, and sales enablement for Nadia, our enterprise AI coaching platform, as Valence's first dedicated Product Marketing Lead. You'll report directly to our VP of Marketing and work closely with sales, product, and executive leadership to sharpen how we tell our story to CHROs and other senior executives and ensure that story lands in every deal our sales team runs.

This is a high-impact role on a lean marketing team operating at startup velocity. The commercial team has strong positioning and messaging acumen, but know-how is scattered across the team. You'll pull it into a coherent, sales-ready system that is essential to helping Valence scale 10x.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Nadia's positioning and messaging — sharpening our narrative and competitive story for CHRO and enterprise-executive buying committees, and keeping it coherent across sales and marketing surfaces

 - Build our sales enablement function: pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling

 - Build a system for competitive intelligence and translate market and competitor research into messaging and enablement assets

 - Work directly with sales leadership to identify where deals accelerate vs. stall and turn those insights into sharper positioning and better-equipped sellers

 - Design go-to-market for new capabilities and launches

 - Lead analyst relations


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of marketing experience, with a track record in enterprise B2B SaaS

 - Extraordinary customer empathy and knack for written and visual language; you can distill a complex product into a series of clear, creative and compelling assets

 - A systems engineering mindset when building and scaling programs and playbooks. You look for 10x leverage through ingenuity, technology, and - most importantly - cutting to the heart of what will create impact.

 - High EQ and experience partnering with, aligning, and getting to shared success with commercial teams.

 - Startup or high-growth company experience: you're comfortable building a function with limited existing infrastructure and shifting priorities. You enjoy and are expert in creating a way forward through ambiguity.

 - Understanding of the buying and competitive landscape in HR tech, people analytics, or L&D/coaching.

 - A drive for excellence: You take full ownership of outcomes. You feel deeply responsible for results. If something’s off, you roll up your sleeves and fix it, even if it’s not “your job.” You challenge yourself to extraordinary growth and believe that frequent feedback is the fastest lever for getting better.

 - You operate above pace: You operate with speed and conviction. You don’t wait for perfect certainty. You choose a path, test it fast, and let results guide the next move.

 - You take bold bets: You lead with curiosity and not ego. You care more about strong ideas than being right. You listen well, challenge directly, and commit fully even when the decision isn’t yours.

 - AI-native: you've built AI into your daily workflow and can point to specific things you've automated, accelerated, or improved with it in the last six months


WHAT YOU'LL GET

Ownership & Rapid Growth

 - Outsized missions from day one, with direct responsibility for company-defining projects

 - Work alongside the executive team with transparency into strategy and decision-making

 - Influence on direction through real-time customer feedback and market insights

AI-First Operator

 - Work directly with cutting-edge AI models and next-generation platforms

 - Build expertise in enterprise AI implementation across Fortune 500 companies and multiple industries

 - Establish yourself as a recognized leader among peers in shaping how AI transforms work at a global scale

Compensation

 - Competitive salary including base + bonuses

 - Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one

 - Generous PTO, company-wide R&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave

 - Retirement plan support for US and global employees

Equity

 - Meaningful ownership in a venture-backed company at a growth inflection point

 - Financial upside that comes from scaling fast

 - Top-up grants as we scale and you deliver exceptional performance — your compensation grows alongside your impact

Top-Performing Culture

 - A culture built for top talent: intensity to win, growth without limits, and a team that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together
